name: Pending RD Schedules for This Month
query:
SELECT
    a.name AS "RD Account:Link/WMS RD Account:200",
    a.holder_name AS "Holder Name:Data:200",
    a.denomination AS "Denomination:Currency:120",
    a.next_installment_date AS "Next Installment Date:Date:200"

FROM `tabWMS RD Account` a

WHERE
    MONTH(a.next_installment_date) = MONTH(%(report_month)s)
    AND YEAR(a.next_installment_date) = YEAR(%(report_month)s)

    AND a.name NOT IN (
        SELECT t.rd_account_number
        FROM `tabWMS RD Transaction` t
        INNER JOIN `tabWMS RD Schedule` s
            ON s.name = t.parent
            AND t.parenttype = 'WMS RD Schedule'
        WHERE
            MONTH(s.schedule_date) = MONTH(%(report_month)s)
            AND YEAR(s.schedule_date) = YEAR(%(report_month)s)
            AND s.docstatus = 1
    )

ORDER BY a.next_installment_date ASC;
report_name: Pending RD Schedules for This Month
